purpose: Full-corpus CafeBERT evaluation of S3 axial/angular/combined, LDA, NMF and BERTopic+UMAP+KMeans on four Vietnamese corpora.

bertopic_vectorizer.name: sklearn_unicode_word_hyphen_bertopic_representation
bertopic_vectorizer.rationale: Fixed min_df=2 only for BERTopic c-TF-IDF topic-word representation because min_df=10 yielded a degenerate c-TF-IDF error on the 858-document corpus during the recorded smoke test. This setting does not affect the shared lexical tokenizer used for WEC-in, C_NPMI, S3, LDA or NMF.

runtime_contract.pipeline_seconds: representation plus model fit plus top-term extraction, excluding evaluation metrics
runtime_contract.representation_s3_and_bertopic: CafeBERT encode from local cached weights
runtime_contract.fit_seconds: model fit plus topic extraction after representation is ready
runtime_contract.metric_seconds: WEC-in, topic diversity, C_NPMI and alphabetic audit computed after topic extraction
runtime_contract.total_cold_seconds: ingest/preprocess plus model loading where applicable plus pipeline_seconds
runtime_contract.shared_representation_policy: Representation is computed once per corpus and recorded as an immutable cold reference; its measured duration is copied into every comparable row instead of timing a cache hit as zero.
